originals: Original PNGs and capture logs remain in Jack's private evidence store on the MacBook Pro. Only the JPEG78 copies are added to the review assets.
limits: Captures show the immutable preview layout at the actual capture time. They do not prove form delivery, CRM behaviour, payment, legal sign-off or client acceptance. Hosted review readback is recorded separately.
